Self-Made Vigilante.name: Self-Made Vigilante
Self-Made Vigilante.description:
🌙 You took to the streets on your own: no license, no record, nobody's permission.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Stealth +5
Self-Made Vigilante.traitNarrativeEffects: The character became a vigilante without a criminal past: no record, no license, no file with the police except rumors of a masked helper.
